+- [ ] Same file: `GraphQLSchemaGolden`, `GraphQLSchemaDescriptions.undescribed` empty, `GraphQLEndpointConformance.problems` empty with an alias probe (EXTRAS-9 rule 11)
+- [ ] `swift test --filter Snapshots` passes
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #graphql #snapshots
